description: Our flagship Cabernet Sauvignon from the 2023 vintage, grown on our hillside estate above St. Helena in Napa Valley.

pages.text: Ridgeline Cellars. Family wines from the ridge above St. Helena. Menu: Visit (https://example.com/visit) · Our Story (https://example.com/our-story) · Wines (https://example.com/wines) · Shop (https://example.com/shop) · Events (https://example.com/events) · Find Our Wines (https://example.com/find-our-wines) · Press (https://example.com/press). Our 2021 Cabernet was rated 95 points! Join the Ridge Club and save 15% on every order.

Visit us. Our tasting room sits on the terrace above the vines, with views across the valley to the Mayacamas. Open Thursday to Monday, 10 am to 4 pm. Tastings are by reservation; book online or call. 1200 Ridgeline Road, St. Helena, CA. Estate tasting of five wines on the terrace. Vineyard and cellar walk, 90 minutes, ending with a barrel tasting. Where to stay: we love the Valley Oak Inn (five minutes away) and Cedar House Bed & Breakfast in town. Where to eat: Olive & Vine for lunch on Main Street, and The Grange for dinner.

Our story. Daniel and Rosa Hale planted their first vines on a steep, rocky ridge above St. Helena in 1998, when everyone told them it was too steep to farm. Twenty-five years later their daughter Maya makes the wines, and the whole family still picks at harvest. We farm 40 acres organically and dry farm every block: no irrigation, so the roots go deep. Every cluster is picked by hand in the cool early morning. We make about 3,000 cases a year in our stone winery, built into the hillside in 2004, with a barrel cave that stays cool all year.

Our wines. Cabernet Sauvignon 2023 (https://example.com/wines/cabernet-sauvignon-2023): our flagship. Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon: from the oldest block on the ridge, made only in the best years. Chardonnay: barrel fermented, from our cool lower block. Sauvignon Blanc: crisp and bright, made in steel. Rosé of Grenache: dry, pale, made for summer. Estate Red Blend: Cabernet, Merlot and Petit Verdot. Gold Medal, 2025 California State Wine Competition.

Cabernet Sauvignon 2023. Napa Valley. 92% Cabernet Sauvignon, 8% Merlot, all from our hillside estate. A cool spring and a long, mild autumn gave small berries with deep color. Blackberry, cassis and black cherry, with cedar, cocoa and a little graphite; firm, fine tannins and a long finish. Aged 20 months in French oak. Drink now with a decant, or cellar for 15 years. Try it with grilled ribeye, braised short ribs or aged cheddar. 14.5% alc. by vol. 750 ml. $68.

Shop. Wines (https://example.com/wines). Gift sets: The Ridge Trio, our Cabernet, Chardonnay and Rosé in a wooden box, $165. Holiday Pair, two bottles of Cabernet with a pair of crystal glasses, $150. Magnum of Cabernet in a gift tube, $145. Ridge Club members save 15%. Free shipping on 6 bottles or more.

Events. October 18, 2026: Harvest Party on the terrace (members $40). December 6, 2026: Holiday Open House with live jazz.
